messages:
Priya (Procurement): looping in finance/eng. BidMeter sent a PO draft and a credits-based rate card. main asks: token->credit mapping, rollover rules, and invoice line granularity.
Amelia (Finance): need explicit conversion (tokens in/out + embeddings) and sample invoice lines for our AP parser. also payment terms — pilot prefers net-45.
Jon S (Eng Ops): our POC used ~1.2M tokens + 50k embeddings. will that be 1,250 credits or different with long-context?
Leo - BidMeter: hi all. baseline: 1 credit = 1k inference tokens OR 10 embedding units. long-context multiplier applies: 1-1024=1x, 1025-4096=2x. so your POC would be ~1,200 credits base, plus sequence multipliers where applicable.
Sasha R (Platform): need to know if multipliers apply per-request or per-session (KV).
Leo - BidMeter: per-request context length at compute time. KV cache reductions are honored — we send tokens_in/tokens_out in metering logs.
Priya (Procurement): rollover? last vendor zeroed unused credits quarterly.
Leo - BidMeter: options: quarterly (30% rollover) or annual (100% rollover with a maintenance fee). both come with monthly reconciliation CSVs.
Amelia (Finance): sample invoice lines please (commit, overage, setup).
Leo - BidMeter: sample: "Quarterly commit Q3  150,000 credits $45,000", "Overage 12,300 credits $3,690", "Private VPC setup $6,000". will attach CSV+PDF after thread.
Jon S (Eng Ops): can we get per-request CSV (request_id, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, embedding_units, timestamp) into our S3 for reconciliation?
Leo - BidMeter: yes — S3 push or presigned link.
Sasha R (Platform): SOC2 + BYOK for private?
Leo - BidMeter: SOC2 Type II yes. BYOK via AWS KMS supported for Private.
Priya (Procurement): proposed next steps: 1) Leo posts full multiplier table + mock invoice CSV, 2) Accounting Bot runs invoice parse, 3) Amelia confirms pilot net-45 budget, 4) Sasha validates BYOK. ack?
Amelia (Finance): ack — will confirm budget tomorrow EOD.
Jon S (Eng Ops): ack — will test CSV with our 1.2M tokens sample.
Sasha R (Platform): ack — will validate BYOK & spot-credit usage for batch.
Accounting Bot: ready to parse when CSV link is provided.
Leo - BidMeter: thanks everyone. I'll upload the table and mock invoice in ~45m and hold the setup concession for 48h. :handshake:
